Maybe the system expects we retrieve the SMILES? Not provided. Could be that the compound is implicit from previous context? No prior messages. So we need to ask for more info? But we can only use tools, not ask user. Maybe the compound is known from task name? task_2_subtask_5 maybe part of a series where earlier subtask gave structure. But we don't have.

We could try to get NMR spectra via proton_nmr_spectra tool, but it requires SMILES input? The tool signature has no parameters. It just returns spectra? Probably uses internal sample. Might be preloaded with the compound. So we can call proton_nmr_spectra to get the 1H NMR data, then count distinct signals (unique chemical shifts). That would give number of unique hydrogen environments.
